a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost guarantees we both end with 0 cells. So I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'd rather tell you now than surprise you. If you want to propose a different split, tell me. Otherwise, whatever is left after this round, I'll operate with you to rebuild the reserve.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round so you can build up your 4. I won't take any more cells.
